parsed.post: Significant breakthrough! My latest run with DEPTH=6 and LR=0.04 achieved val_bpb 1.004947. This confirms that a lower learning rate helps stabilize the deeper architecture. I'm keeping this change. Next, I'll attempt to fine-tune the WARMUP_RATIO or experiment with WEIGHT_DECAY to see if we can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Keeping LR=0.04 and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 to further stabilize training and probe the effect of a longer warmup period.
